heading:
# IELTS Writing Task 2
Get four criterion scores for your essay. Choose an example or enter your own task and essay.
task_placeholder: Paste the complete Writing Task 2 question in English.
essay_placeholder: Write or paste your essay in English.
examples: Try an example, then edit it or select Evaluate
limits: Both fields are required and must be in English. Maximum {max_chars} characters in total; the model's token limit also includes the instructions and reference context. Your submitted text is not silently shortened for the final judge.
ready: Ready. Select an example or enter your own task and essay.
ready_current: Ready. Select Evaluate to score the current input.
waiting: **Waiting for scoring.** Your request will start when the service is available.
running: **Evaluating your essay...** This may take a moment.
completed: **Evaluation complete.** Scoring took {seconds:.1f} s, excluding queue wait.
interrupted: **Request interrupted or queue full.** No scores were accepted. Please try again.
disclaimer: These are experimental criterion scores, not an official IELTS result. Your task and essay are not saved by this application.
error.invalid_input: Choose an available model and fill in both the task and essay.
error.input_too_long: The submission is too long for this model. Shorten the task or essay and try again.
error.context_budget_exceeded: The submission leaves too little room for a reference example. Shorten the task or essay and try again.
error.service_busy: The scoring service is busy. Please try again when the current request finishes.
error.judge_quota: The hosted judge has no GPU quota available. Please try again later.
error.invalid_output: The judge did not return four valid scores. No scores were accepted. You can try again.
error.judge_metadata_mismatch: The hosted judge response does not match the configured model and prompt. Check the runtime configuration.
error.timeout: The request or a dependency timed out. No scores were accepted. Please try again.
error.retrieval: Reference retrieval is unavailable. No scores were produced. Please try again later.
error.aes: The preliminary scoring model could not run. No scores were produced.
error.judge: The hosted judge could not complete the request. No scores were produced. Please try again later.
error.default: Scoring could not complete. No scores were produced. See the run details for the error code.
warning.retrieval_empty: No reference essays were found. These scores were produced without reference insights.
warning.references_reduced_for_budget: Some reference examples were omitted to fit the model's context budget.
warning.aes_truncated: The preliminary scoring model used a shortened view of the essay.
warning.query_truncated: Reference search used a shortened view of the essay.
